**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Warburton](../persons.html#1465),
I am sorry to say I have to dine with a great wedding party on Monday at my [brother](../persons.html#1624)’s, as [Miss Walter](../persons.html#616)’s wedding is to be on Tuesday, so that I am obliged to miss the pleasure you kindly propose to me

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Louisa Walter married Francis Edward Halliday in Otterbourne on Tuesday 7 August 1866.
